title: 第 1章 顾家有个小傻子
novel_title: 六零：冲喜？退伍糙汉夜夜疯！(豌豆饼干)
content_zh: “顾家有个小傻子，只会吃饭，不会叫娘，抓着粑粑当干粮.......”“死丫头，赔钱货，一天啥都不知道，活着也是浪费粮食，你怎么还不去找你娘去.........”“岁岁不怕，岁岁不怕，有姐姐在呢，姐姐会护着你的，肚子饿了吧，快吃快吃......”“我们秀秀怎么能嫁给一个活死人，就让她去，一个傻子配一个活死人正正好.......”“新娘子进门喽.......”..........顾岁岁半梦半醒间翻了个身。忽然，身旁一道清浅的呼吸声让她瞬间睁开了眼睛。身旁有人？顾岁岁茫然的扭头朝旁边看去，然后随着视线逐渐清晰，她的眼睛也越睁越大。昏暗的房间里视线不明，却也让她看到一个骨瘦如柴的男人躺在她的身边。什么情况，她被赵家那对混蛋夫妻给卖到大山里去了？顾岁岁的神经瞬间紧绷起来，赶紧翻身坐起，迅速的与那人拉开了距离，直到退到了墙根儿底下，她才如小兽般仔细打量着周围的环境。灰扑扑的土墙，简陋的房间，身后还有一扇五十见方的小窗户......顾岁岁紧紧的皱起了眉头，她不是已经亲眼看到赵家夫妻变成丧尸了吗？而且她记得昏迷前是在大型商超零元购，怎么会出现在这个陌生的地方。顾岁岁感受着周围的寂静，忽然想起刚才闪现在她脑海里的那些记忆和画面。一个刚出生时就被判定为痴傻的女孩儿，从小被人嘲笑，亲娘早死，亲爹娶了后娘，被姐姐护着照顾着长大。然后堂姐落水，救她的军人发生意外昏迷不醒，想要娶个媳妇儿回来冲喜的时候，一家人为了二十斤粮食就把她推了出来，姐姐弟弟还因为反抗而被那些人囚禁.......顾岁岁难以掩饰心里的惊讶，她不会穿越了吧！在重生了一次后，又穿越了？上辈子她是在孤儿院长大的，为了将来能有个稳定的工作，她就使劲的卷，终于在大三那年成功上岸了。然而，正当她准备出去好好犒劳一下自已时，却忽然被亲生父母找上了门。那夫妻俩看到她就是一阵抱头痛哭，这夫妻俩说明原因后，就像是要弥补她曾经失去的东西，好吃好喝的伺候着，还第一时间带她去检查了身体。原本以为这就是血脉亲情，然而在一个月后，她才知道父母找他是因为她亲哥得了绝症，想要她一个肾。顾岁岁又不是傻子，跟赵家人又没感情，怎么可能就因为这一个月的相处就给出去一个肾，所以她拒绝了。可惜，她还是低估了这些人的狠毒，就在她拒绝后决定离开的时候，赵家人将她给绑了起来，准备强行进行手术。不过，让所有人都没想到的是，还没等他们动手，末世降临了，几天之内整个世界都乱了套，逃难都来不及，谁还有心思管她。而她就这么被困在地下室无人问津，末世三天后，她觉醒了空间异能，但是空荡荡的空间里什么都没有，她活生生的给饿死了。谁知一睁眼，她又站在了学校门口看到赵家父母抱着她痛哭流涕。顾岁岁稍微想了一下，乖乖的跟着他们回了赵家，还相当配合他们的去了医院检查。最后检查结果出来，赵家人如上辈子一样，嘘寒问暖，又是吃又是喝的有求必应。赵家有钱，虽然达不到世界五百强，但身价也有十几个亿。而顾岁岁没钱，她靠勤工俭学才攒下钱交了学费。眼下既然赵家有求于她，她也不客气，吃喝不拒绝，还张嘴要钱。几万几万的要，赵家不想给，她就说要走。现在窗户纸还没捅破，赵家也想让她心甘情愿的配合，只好想着掏钱买亲情。断断续续的顾岁岁从赵家要走了四五十万，她全都用来买末世用得着的储备物资了。等到一个月后，不知道赵家是觉得差不多了，还是赵家大儿子那等不了了，他们才开口说了换肾的事儿。顾岁岁没有一口回绝，只是在考虑过后表示，换肾可以，但是要给她钱。她要了两个亿，如果不同意，她说什么都不会答应。那么多钱，赵家肯定不会同意的，还想故技重施，但顾岁岁既然提了，又知道赵家人的德性，那她自然事提前做足了准备。反正最后的结果是她先拿到了一个亿，事成之后，赵家会把另外一个亿给她。顾岁岁痛快的跟他们签了合同。有了充足的资金，顾岁岁放开了买东西。末世她只在地下室经历了几天，不知道具体什么情况，她为了学习也从不看小说，为了了解情况还特意去找了两本。然后就按照小说上的内容，只要能用的着的她都买。反正有钱，可以随心所欲的花。衣食住行，主餐，配餐，零食，小吃，鸡鸭鱼肉.......直到她把一个亿全都花光了，末世也降临了。眼看着赵家人成了丧尸，她在顺利活下来的同时，还有机会去了一个大型商超，三层楼，她从上跑到下，在一片混乱中，她把所有的东西都给收了，连仓库里的都没放过。而正当她有了足够的安全感，躲在一楼黄金柜台，美滋滋的打算喝口水喘口气就去她提前租好的安全屋时，忽然从天而降一个不知道啥东西落在了她的脑袋上，连个反应的机会都没给她，眼前一黑就失去了知觉。再次醒来，没想到迎接她的不是末世的丧尸，竟然是穿越到了一九六零年。这个时期离她那时候有几十年的时间，对于这时候的历史她了解的不是很清楚。只知道几个大事件的发生，建国时间，土地改革，三年自然灾害，大运动开始，恢复高考.......而现在就是三年灾害的第二年，从原主有限的记忆里看，所有人家确实都很穷，穷到衣服都没得穿，饭都没得吃。去年全国大面积受灾，田地里的粮食收成十不存一。他们这里哪怕受灾没有那么严重，也好不到哪儿去，只是少饿死几个人而已。记忆里，顾家一天只有两顿饭，早晨一顿稀汤水配野菜，中午一顿菜叶子配稀汤水，外加半个黑面馒头。
content_en: "There is a little fool in the Gu family. He only knows how to eat, but he can't call me mother. He grabs daddy for dry food..." "You damn girl, you lose money. You don't know anything all day long. Living is a waste of food. Why don't you go to your mother..." "Don't be afraid every year, don't be afraid every year. My sister is here, and she will protect me.Take yours, you are hungry, eat quickly..." "How can our Xiuxiu marry a living dead, just let her go, a fool is just right for a living dead..." "The bride is coming in..."... Gu Suisui turned over half asleep and half awake.Suddenly, a shallow breath beside her made her open her eyes instantly.Is there anyone next to you?Gu Suisui turned her head and looked to the side in confusion, and then her eyes opened wider as her vision gradually became clearer.The sight in the dim room was unclear, but she also saw a skinny man lying next to her.What happened? She was sold to the mountains by that bastard couple from the Zhao family?Gu Suisui's nerves tensed up instantly. She quickly turned over and sat up, quickly distanced herself from the man. It wasn't until she retreated to the base of the wall that she carefully looked at her surroundings like a little animal.Dusty earthen walls, a simple room, and a small fifty-square window behind it... Gu Suisui frowned tightly, hadn't she already seen the Zhao couple turn into zombies with her own eyes?And she remembered that before she fell into coma, she went to a large supermarket to buy something for zero yuan. How could she appear in this strange place?Gu Suisui felt the silence around her, and suddenly remembered the memories and pictures that had just flashed in her mind.A girl who was judged to be stupid when she was born was ridiculed since she was a child. Her mother died early, her father married her stepmother, and she was protected and cared for by her sister as she grew up.Then her cousin fell into the water, and the soldier who rescued her had an accident and fell into a coma. When she wanted to marry a daughter-in-law and come back to celebrate the wedding, the family pushed her out for twenty kilograms of food. Her sister and brother were imprisoned by those people because of their resistance... Gu Suisui couldn't hide his surprise, she couldn't have traveled through time!After being reborn once, traveled through time again?In her previous life, she grew up in an orphanage. In order to have a stable job in the future, she studied hard and finally successfully landed in college in her junior year.However, just when she was about to go out to treat herself, she was suddenly visited by her biological parents.When the couple saw her, they hugged each other and cried. After explaining the reason, the couple seemed to want to make up for what she had lost. They served her delicious food and drinks, and took her for a physical check-up as soon as possible.She originally thought this was a blood relationship, but a month later, she learned that her parents were looking for her because her brother was terminally ill and wanted a kidney from her.Gu Suisui was not a fool, and she had no relationship with the Zhao family. How could she give him a kidney just because they had been together for a month, so she refused.Unfortunately, she still underestimated the viciousness of these people. When she decided to leave after refusing, the Zhao family tied her up and prepared to perform forced surgery on her.However, what no one expected was that before they could take action, the apocalypse came. Within a few days, the whole world was in chaos, and it was too late to escape. Who would care about her.And she was trapped in the basement without anyone paying attention. Three days after the end of the world, she awakened her space powers, but there was nothing in the empty space, and she starved to death.Unexpectedly, when she opened her eyes, she stood at the school gate again and saw Zhao's parents holding her and crying bitterly.Gu Suisui thought for a moment and followed them back to Zhao's house obediently. He also cooperated with them in going to the hospital for examination.When the final test results came out, the Zhao family was just like they had been in the previous life. They asked for help, and they ate and drank everything they asked for.The Zhao family is rich. Although they are not among the top 500 in the world, they are worth more than a billion.Gu Suisui had no money, so she relied on work-study to save money to pay for her tuition.Now that the Zhao family is asking for something from her, she is not polite, refuses to eat or drink, and even asks for money.She asked for tens of thousands, but the Zhao family didn't want to give it, so she said she wanted to leave.Now that the window paper has not been pierced, the Zhao family also wants her to cooperate willingly, so they can only think of spending money to buy family affection.On and off, Gu Suisui took away four to five million yuan from the Zhao family, and she used all of it to buy supplies that would be needed in the end of the world.After a month, whether the Zhao family felt that it was almost done or the eldest son of the Zhao family couldn't wait any longer, they started talking about the kidney transplant.Gu Suisui did not refuse outright, but after thinking about it, she said that a kidney transplant was possible, but she would have to pay for it.She asked for 200 million, and if she didn't agree, she wouldn't agree to anything.The Zhao family would definitely not agree to such a large sum of money and wanted to repeat the same trick. But since Gu Suisui mentioned it and knew the character of the Zhao family, she was naturally well prepared in advance.Anyway, the final result was that she got 100 million first, and after the deal was completed, the Zhao family would give her the other 100 million.Gu Suisui happily signed the contract with them.With sufficient funds, Gu Suisui started shopping.She only experienced the apocalypse in the basement for a few days, and she didn't know the specific situation. She never read novels in order to study, and went to find two books to understand the situation.Then according to the content in the novel, she bought everything that could be used.Anyway, if you have money, you can spend it as you like.Food, clothing, housing, transportation, main meals, side meals, snacks, snacks, chicken, duck, fish...until she spent all 100 million, and the end came.Seeing that the Zhao family became zombies, while she survived successfully, she still had the opportunity to go to a large supermarket on the three floors. She ran from top to bottom. In the chaos, she collected everything, even those in the warehouse.And just when she felt safe enough to hide at the gold counter on the first floor, happily planning to take a sip of water and catch her breath before going to the safe house she had rented in advance, something suddenly fell from the sky and landed on her head. She didn't even have a chance to react, and she lost consciousness as soon as her vision went dark.When she woke up again, she didn't expect that what greeted her was not the zombies of the apocalypse, but that she had traveled to 1960.This period was several decades away from her time, and she didn't know much about the history at this time.I only know about the occurrence of a few major events, the founding of the People's Republic of China, land reform, three years of natural disasters, the beginning of the Great Movement, the resumption of the college entrance examination... and now is the second year of the three years of disasters. Judging from the limited memory of the original owner, all the families are indeed very poor, so poor that they have no clothes to wear and no food to eat.Last year, large areas of the country were hit by disasters, and the grain harvest in the fields was reduced to a tenth.Even if the disaster here isn't that severe, it's not much better. It's just that a few fewer people have starved to death.In my memory, the Gu family only had two meals a day, a thin soup with wild vegetables in the morning, and a thin soup with vegetable leaves and water at noon, plus half a black-faced steamed bun.
